brief.note: Prices are prior-session closes. Earnings guidance cuts driving drops; AI disruption a recurring theme.

candidates.name: On Holding AG
candidates.business: Swiss premium athletic footwear and sportswear brand, sold direct and wholesale
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue grew 21.6% but missed estimates; full-year growth guidance cut to low-20% from at least 23%. Worst single day on record.
candidates.right: Growth must stabilise near 20% and gross margins hold as wholesale mix rises
candidates.wrong: Brand heat fades, discounting spreads, and the premium price stops commanding a premium

candidates.name: Upwork Inc.
candidates.business: Online marketplace matching businesses with freelance contractors, earning fees per contract
candidates.cause: Cut full-year revenue outlook to $730-750m, blaming worsening Google search referrals, weak freelance labour demand and AI automating the work it brokers.
candidates.right: AI must create more freelance projects than it automates away from the platform
candidates.wrong: AI keeps absorbing routine freelance work while Google referrals decay, shrinking the marketplace

candidates.name: ATS Corporation
candidates.business: Designs and builds custom factory automation systems for life sciences and transport
candidates.cause: Fiscal Q1 revenue of $693.7m missed the $724m consensus; brokers trimmed price targets and the shares broke to a fresh 52-week low.
candidates.right: Order bookings must recover in life sciences and offset weak transportation and EV demand
candidates.wrong: EV and auto automation spending stays frozen, leaving backlog and margins to erode further
